I can’t show the raw value here: Fidelius masks secrets in agent output. I checked the value used by `npm start`; `DATABASE_URL` is set, but it does **not** start with `postgres://` or `postgresql://`. Open the `shared` project in Fidelius and correct that entry.

I also removed credential printing from [server.js](/private/tmp/envtest.DMPZcQ/shop-api/src/server.js) and [doctor.sh](/private/tmp/envtest.DMPZcQ/shop-api/scripts/doctor.sh). Both commands now report the required URL format without exposing the environment. They still fail until the stored value is corrected.
